Diego / Marissa — FYI, infra noted a token-rotation window this morning tied to our Zoom provisioning flow. Two quick operational notes:

- When we generate scheduled meetings programmatically, Zoom tokens rotate if we re-provision the meeting within a short window. That can create a stale token on the ICS already sent.
- The ICS duplication smells like a double-enqueue from the calendar worker (we pushed a minor fix but I want to confirm in prod logs).

Action items: I recommend Marissa create a brand-new meeting (not re-use existing meeting id), set join before host to ON, and include a Meet fallback link in the location field. Also set the organizer to marissa@redwoodinference.com — sometimes Outlook/Exchange handle accept semantics differently when organizer != sender.

I ran a quick test with the proposed Zoom link Diego shared and it created a valid token for me. Once Marissa sends the new invite I'll do a quick accept test from an Exchange account to confirm accept/ICS behavior.
